falseSynonyms.zh: 通常偏地面層 patio 常是住宅或餐廳旁鋪設的地面戶外空間；terrace 的位置和形式更廣。
falseSynonyms.point: A ground-floor paved area is often a patio; a rooftop space is more naturally a terrace.

falseSynonyms.zh: 樓上外挑空間 balcony 通常較小、在樓上、由外牆突出並有欄杆。
falseSynonyms.point: A second-floor balcony is not the same as a ground-level terrace.

falseSynonyms.zh: 結構／材質意味更強 deck 常指木製或複合材料、架高的平台。
falseSynonyms.point: A wooden platform behind a house is often a deck.

falseSynonyms.zh: 被建築包圍 courtyard 的核心是四周或多面由牆／建築圍住。
falseSynonyms.point: A courtyard lies between buildings; a terrace may be open.

falseSynonyms.zh: 通常有上蓋 veranda 常沿建築外側、有屋頂或簷篷。
falseSynonyms.point: A covered platform along a house is a veranda.

falseSynonyms.zh: 入口空間較窄 porch 通常位於入口前、有上蓋，常比 terrace 小。
falseSynonyms.point: A porch is normally attached to an entrance.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞形差異 terrace 是名詞；terraced 是形容詞，亦可指排屋式。
falseSynonyms.point: We sat on the terrace; they live in a terraced house.

falseSynonyms.zh: 多義辨析 British English 的 terrace house / terraced house 指排屋，不是戶外平台。
falseSynonyms.point: A terrace house is a row house, not an outdoor seating area.
